title: Job Hunt Copilot
description: Collect listings, score fit, draft cover letters, maintain a draft tracker and prepare for interviews.

assignments.task: Collect current listings from the owner's feed URLs or official APIs and score them against the supplied profile with evidence.
Draft tailored cover letters and interview preparation using only verified profile facts.
Produce a deduplicated application-tracker table with source links, fit scores, stage and next steps.

fields.label: Sources, evidence and owner instructions
fields.help: {listings?, profile?, interviewEmail?}; RSS and IMAP triggers supply their ordinary item/message payload.

instructions: Read supplied RSS items, official listing APIs, permitted public pages or incoming interview messages. Preserve listing dates, links and status; distinguish expired listings and missing evidence. Never invent qualifications or submit applications. Keep cover letters, application-tracker rows and interview preparation in the workflow result for owner use.
prerequisites: Configure the required model roles in Settings. Agent grants and current account/MCP/Bridge permissions must be explicitly reviewed; installing a recipe does not add them.
Provide a truthful candidate profile and permitted listing sources; an interview inbox needs an IMAP account.
approvalPoints: Applications are never submitted by this template. All results are drafts.
limitations: The default search tool is Wikipedia, not a job index; supply actual feeds, URLs or a reviewed official MCP job API. Tracker changes are returned as a draft table.
eventContract: {listings?, profile?, interviewEmail?}; RSS and IMAP triggers supply their ordinary item/message payload.
